mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_history(user_id, login_time) VALUES (#{id}, NOW());
mapper.update: UPDATE login_history SET logout_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{id} AND logout_time IS NULL ORDER BY login_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT login_time AS loginTime, logout_time AS logoutTime, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, login_time, logout_time) >= 3600 THEN CONCAT( FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, login_time, logout_time) / 3600), '시간 ', FLOOR((TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, login_time, logout_time) % 3600) / 60), '분' ) ELSE CONCAT( FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, login_time, logout_time) / 60), '분' ) END AS duration FROM login_history WHERE user_id = #{id} AND logout_time IS NOT NULL
